And the aspect of wisdom, might, and wealth, from which the spirit of prophecy is drawn to faith — all of these are included in the holy union. For the drop descends from the wisdom that is in the mind, as is known, and descends in the aspect of might — for the bris is called “Bo’az” — bo oz, bo tokfa (in it is strength, in it is might), as is brought. And the drop itself, which is for the sake of the begetting of souls, is the aspect of the influence of wealth. For all the souls have their root in wealth, as is brought in his words, of blessed memory, Siman 69.

And therefore all her acquisition is through money, the aspect of wealth, as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of the k’subah that he must give her, so that his cohabitation should not be licentious cohabitation, as our Sages, of blessed memory, said. For he must guarantee her in writing that there will remain with her from him the influence of wealth even when she separates from him, whether through a get (bill of divorce) or through death — in order that the bond should be firm and strong and enduring forever, for the sake of revealing the holy faith according to the root of their souls in the supernal holiness. And this is drawn through the money of the k’subah that he guarantees her will remain in her possession — to indicate that the influence he draws to her through the union endures forever, for it is drawn from the aspect of the spirit of prophecy that is drawn through wisdom, might, and wealth, the essential being the aspect of wealth, from which comes the entire drawing down of the souls, etc., as mentioned above.

And therefore it must endure forever — that even if she separates from him, the influence of wealth should remain in her possession, which is two hundred zuz, which is the measure of wealth, as is brought above. And through this the chitzonim (external forces) will not have dominion and will not draw sustenance from her — they being the aspect of the wisdom of nature, who constantly lie in ambush for the imaginative faculty, the aspect of faith, which is the aspect of the wife, when she is far from the tzadik, who is the aspect of her husband. But now they will not have the power to take hold of her, for she has already received from her husband the influence of wealth, which is the aspect of the spirit of prophecy, through which faith is constantly clarified and strengthened, as mentioned above.

And therefore he must give her the k’subah in writing specifically. And likewise when he wishes to distance her and divorce her, he must give her a get (bill of divorce) in writing specifically. For the essential tikkun of the bond and the connection is that she should be subordinate to him, for b’asar d’is d’char, nukba la id’char saman (in a place where the male is present, the female is not mentioned there). For he must rule over her, as it is written: “And he shall rule over you” (Bereishis 3:16). For kad nukba shalt’a al d’chura (when the female rules over the male), G-d forbid, then dina sakifa (harsh judgment prevails), G-d forbid, as is brought in the holy Zohar. That is, for the root of the union far, far above, at its source, is the aspect of the unification of Havayah and Elokim. And this is the essential tikkun — to know and to make known and to have it known that “Hashem — He is the Elokim.”

For Elokim is the aspect of the drawing down of His G-dly vitality that is enclothed within all the worlds, from level to level, down to this lowly, lowest world. And this is the aspect of Malchus, the aspect of Elokim, as it says: “And Elokim is my King from of old” (Tehillim 74:12). And the Name Havayah is the aspect of the Essential Name, the aspect of His essential G-dliness, blessed be He, which is hidden from every eye, in the aspect of: “This is My Name, for concealment” (Sh’mos 3:15), as all of this is understood in the writings [of the Ari]. And therefore it is brought that Elokim has the gematria (numerical value) of hateva (nature). For in truth, even nature — all its vitality comes from His G-dliness, blessed be He, from the aspect of the Name Elokim. Only He, blessed be He, conceals Himself within the governance of nature for the sake of free choice, in the aspect of: “Truly, You are a G-d who hides Himself” (Yeshayah 45:15). And from this concealment — from there is the root of din (judgment), from which comes all the hold of the yetzer hara and the Sitra Achara and the k’lipos and all their hosts.

And the essential root of the union is to unify the Name Elokim with the Name Havayah, blessed be He — to believe and to know that “Hashem — He is the Elokim,” for everything is one in the ultimate unity. For His vitality that is hidden and concealed in this world within nature, which is the aspect of Elokim, is the One who brings all into being Himself, blessed be He, which is the aspect of the Name Havayah, blessed be He. And all of this is the aspect of the root of husband and wife at their supernal root, as is known — for at the root of their souls, the two of them are one. For all the souls emerge male and female together, as is brought. Only below they are divided and separated so much, until it is as difficult to match them as the splitting of the Reed Sea, etc.

And the essential purpose of their union is for the sake of this aspect — to effect the supernal unification mentioned above, from which come all the begettings. And it is all for the sake of revealing His G-dliness and His unity, blessed be He, for this is why man was created, and for this are all the begettings in the world — for “in the image of G-d He made man” (Bereishis 9:6). And as it says: “And G-d created man in His image; in the image of G-d He created him; male and female He created them” (Bereishis 1:27). And as we bless at the time of entering [under the canopy]: “Who fashioned man in His image,” etc.

Only, because all human beings in this world — the man and the woman — have descended through so very many levels of descent until they have come into this physical world in these coarse and physical bodies, therefore the aspect of the hold of din has become greatly attached to them. And especially in the woman — therefore there is the intensification of all the desires and the yetzer hara, whose essence is in this desire. For such is its way: wherever the holiness is higher, there it clings most tenaciously, as it says: “For he has done greatly” (Yo’el 2:20), as our Sages, of blessed memory, said.

But nevertheless, when one conducts oneself at least according to the Torah, according to the law of Moshe and Israel, great unifications are effected through every union, and all the souls are born through this — through which they reveal His G-dliness, blessed be He. And the essential thing is through the power of the true tzadikim, the b’nei aliyah (those who ascend). For there are great and awesome tzadikim who have broken their physical desire to such an extent that they have nullified themselves completely, until they have merited that all their union, even in the physical, is without any desire at all, but only for the sake of the supernal unification, etc. — fortunate are they! And from their power, the tikkun is drawn for all who enter the world.

And therefore the entire tikkun of the world is that people should nullify their minds before these tzadikim specifically — they being the aspect of the Patriarchs and Moshe Rabbeinu, etc. And through them comes the essential knowledge of His G-dliness, blessed be He — to know that “Hashem — He is the Elokim” — that all the lower worlds that appear to be governed according to nature, which are in their generality in the aspect of the wife, are governed by the Creator, blessed be He, who oversees them and bestows upon them their vitality at every moment and instant. And none of them have any vitality except from Him, blessed be He, for everything is one, for “Hashem — He is the Elokim,” as mentioned above.

And all of this is the aspect of the Written Torah and the Oral Torah, which are the aspect of Hashem and Elokim, as is brought. Therefore he must give her the k’subah in writing specifically — to indicate that she is subordinate and nullified to him, for all her vitality is only from him, who is in the aspect of the Written Torah. And likewise when he divorces her, he must divorce her in writing specifically. For from there is the root of her vitality, and from there is the essential root of their union. And likewise when they need to separate — from there specifically he must separate her from him, in order to separate her from him from her root in him, which is the aspect of writing, the aspect of the Written Torah, as mentioned above. For the Written Torah and the Oral Torah are the aspect of the root of husband and wife, as is brought. And the two of them are one at their root, for it is impossible to know anything from the Written Torah except through the Oral Torah, which explains everything — just as it is impossible for the husband to beget any offspring except through the wife. And as it is in the holy Zohar: D’leis rashu l’arka bircha’an (there is no permission to send forth blessings), etc., except through her, etc. But nevertheless, although all the begettings and the entire governance of the world is through her, for she is in the aspect of the mainstay of the home, as mentioned above — nevertheless, one must know that she has no power and no vitality at all except from her husband, from the aspect of the Written Torah. For the entire Oral Torah is all from the Written Torah, for leika milsa d’la r’miza b’Oraysa (there is nothing that is not hinted at in the Torah).

For the Written Torah and the Oral Torah — this is the aspect of the aforementioned permutations. For the word itself, as it is written in the Torah — this is the aspect of the Written Torah. And all the permutations that can be formed from it — this is the aspect of the root of the Oral Torah, which explains and interprets the words of the Torah by way of p’shat, remez, drush, and sod — whether in the elucidation of the laws of the Torah in their details with all their rules, or in the secret of the intentions of the mitzvos and in wondrous drushim and chiddushim (novel Torah insights), etc. For they are all drawn from the aspect of the aforementioned permutations, for through their holy spirit they perceive how to permute the letters of the Torah in so very many different permutations, from which are drawn all the elucidations of the Torah according to the thirteen hermeneutical principles by which the Torah is expounded, and all the chiddushim and all the allusions and the secrets, etc.

But in truth, the two of them are one — the Written Torah and the Oral Torah. That is, the essence of the words as they are, as they are written in the Written Torah, together with all the many permutations that are formed from them without end, which are the aspect of the Oral Torah. For this is the essential tikkun — to unify the two of them as one in the ultimate unity. For after all the multitude of permutations and drushim and intentions and allusions, etc., everything comes back to one place — which is the fulfillment of the Torah and the mitzvos in their plain sense.

For example, the mitzvah of tefillin, which is written in Parashas Kadeish: “And it shall be when Hashem brings you,” etc. In every letter and in every word and in every verse and in every parashah there are secrets and mysteries, deep and awesome, without end, whose root is from all the aforementioned permutations. But nevertheless, after all the drushim and the intentions, etc., the essential thing is as it is written in the Torah, according to what our Sages, of blessed memory, explained to us — which is to put on these tefillin that we put on, which are made of leather, etc., with all their laws. And in them are included all the permutations and all the intentions and the secrets. And so it is with all the mitzvos in the Torah. For the Oral Torah explains all the words of the Written Torah, but it has no existence except from the aspect of the Written Torah — for the two of them are one, as mentioned above.

And from this you will understand from afar how to distinguish between the holy and the profane and the impure — that is, between the holy path that our fathers and our masters trod, in Shas and Poskim and in the ways of the holy Kabbalah that they received from Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him, upon which the holy Zohar and the writings of the Ari, of blessed memory, were founded according to their holy spirit — and between the bitterness of the willful waters of those who go to interpret the holy Torah according to the way of the philosophical investigators, who are not from the children of Israel.

For all the true interpreters of the Torah, according to the Kabbalah, in p’shat and in sod — they all return to one place, and strengthen and arouse and inflame the hearts of the children of Israel greatly to fulfill all the mitzvos in their plain sense as our Sages, of blessed memory, transmitted them to us. For all their interpretations and their elucidations and their chiddushim are from the root of the Written Torah as it is written before us, from which come all the many permutations without end, from which come all their chiddushim, as mentioned above. But everything returns to one place — to fulfill the words of the Torah and its mitzvos according to law and rule, as our Sages, of blessed memory, received.

Not so those who pervert the paths of the upright, who go in the way of philosophy and wish to turn the bowl upside down. And they say that they want only the plain meaning of the Torah, and they deny all the secrets, etc. And afterward, their words lead to throwing off the yoke entirely, as is apparent — their thoughts are discernible from their evil deeds. For certainly, if the reasons for the mitzvos, G-d forbid, are merely conventional, for the sake of maintaining society, etc., as they fabricate from their hearts — then certainly it is impossible to stand up in the battle to conquer one’s evil inclination for the sake of this, as is known and understood to anyone who has any familiarity with their evil words — the bitter, the piercing, like the thrusts of a sword — with their bitter taste of the chalamush (poisonous weed) of theirs upon the mitzvos.

For the Sitra Achara sharei b’chibura v’sayeim b’feruda (begins with union and ends with separation). They begin with the connection of the letters of the Torah as they are, and they do not want the received tradition of our Sages, of blessed memory. And afterward they come to complete separation, in the aspect of: “And a gossiper separates the chief” (Mishlei 16:28) — they separate the Oral Torah from the Written Torah, until they bring about the throwing off of the yoke entirely, as already many of them have actually converted their religion entirely through this. And those who remain in the name of Israel — it is only superficially, and they throw off the yoke of most of the mitzvos entirely. For all their evil interpretations with which they interpret the Torah according to their way are separated from the true, essential intent of the Written Torah, as any person of understanding who desires the truth will be able to comprehend.

But we who walk in the footsteps of our fathers and our masters, from time immemorial — all the drushim and all the chiddushim, etc., and all the intentions and the secrets, etc. — they are all to strengthen and fortify and arouse the hearts of the children of Israel to fulfill all the mitzvos with even greater vigor, with fear and love and wondrous arousal. For even one who does not understand the ways of the secrets and the allusions understands from afar that there are hidden mysteries, awesome and exalted, in every law and in every particular detail of every mitzvah. For everything returns to one place, for the Written Torah and the Oral Torah are all one, for “Hashem — He is the Elokim,” as mentioned above. Blessed is our G-d who created us for His glory and separated us from these errant ones, and gave us a Torah of truth, etc.

And this is the aspect of: “The wisdoms of women have built her house, but foolishness tears it down with her own hands” (Mishlei 14:1). This is said regarding the true wisdom of the Torah, which is called eishes chayil (a woman of valor), the aspect of “the wisdoms of women,” etc. And conversely, the foolishness of the investigators of nature, who are referred to throughout Seifer Mishlei by the name of the strange woman, the adulteress, the foolish woman — as is explained in Rashi and in all the books of the true commentators. For a literal harlot and the heresies of the investigators of nature are actually the same aspect, according to all the above. And likewise, an eishes chayil, a wise and proper wife, is the same aspect as the holy faith that is clarified through the wisdom of the Torah, which is the true wisdom.

And this is: “The wisdoms of women have built her house” — the aspect of the wondrous houses that are made through the many permutations without end, which are all built and founded in firmness and strength, since they all return to one place — to fulfill the Torah and the mitzvos, as mentioned above. But: “And foolishness” — which is the investigators of nature — “tears it down with her own hands,” for they wish to tear down all the wondrous aforementioned houses, since all their words are to distance from the truth of the Torah, as mentioned above.

And this is why the k’subah and the get begin with: “On such-and-such a day of the week,” etc., according to the counting that we count from the creation of the world — to reveal in them the faith of the renewal of the world. For this is the essential faith that is clarified through the true tzadik, from which comes the entire tikkun of the union at its root, as mentioned above.

And likewise regarding divorce — he must divorce her and separate her from her root in him, and it is impossible to separate her except according to the law of Moshe and Israel. That is, through the Torah, which is the aspect of the generality of the spirit of prophecy that clarifies faith, from which comes the union, as mentioned above. And therefore one must ascend there in order to effect the separation from there. For she is not his destined match, since they have come to the point of separation such that he divorces her. For when she is not his destined match and there are many quarrels between them until they cannot reconcile their minds — and all the more so when he has found in her actual ervas davar (a matter of immorality) — then it is impossible to effect through them the unification of nature and Providence, etc., as mentioned above.

For sometimes the investigators of nature become clever against the truth of Providence, which is the aspect of: “The adulteress — under her husband she takes strangers” (Yechezkel 16:32) — who turn away from the truth of faith and go after foreign opinions, etc. And from there is drawn all the damage even in the physical realm between the couples, until he is compelled to divorce her. And then he must separate her from her root, as mentioned above.

For every man and woman are the aspect of particular intellects who need to receive from each other specifically — just as it is at the root, in the knowledge of the Torah and its secrets, where each one needs to receive from the intellect that pertains to him specifically. And if he receives from another intellect that does not pertain to him, he can cause great damage. And therefore one truly needs a very great and distinguished Rabbi who can illuminate each and every person according to his intellect, according to the time and the level that is his. And from there is the root of husband and wife, giver and receiver, as mentioned above — that the soul of this wife needs to receive from this husband specifically. And when she does not pertain to him, from there come the divorces.

And therefore the get must be in writing, and must mention therein the faith of the renewal of the world, as mentioned above, and according to the law of Moshe and Israel — to indicate that he separates her only from himself, for she does not pertain to him. But she is still bound according to the law of the holy Torah, and she has permission to marry whomever she wishes and to be rectified through him. And therefore the get is called a seifer (book/scroll), for it receives from the aspect of Seifer HaTorah (the Torah scroll). And the get serves her as proof and as witness that she has not been separated, G-d forbid, from the Torah entirely — only from this particular man. But she is still bound to the Torah, for she has been released from him according to the law of Moshe and Israel, etc., as mentioned above.

And this is the aspect of yibum (levirate marriage) and chalitzah (removal of the shoe). For it is already explained that the essential purpose of begetting is in order to multiply a soul from Israel, through which the houses multiply greatly, etc. And the essential begetting is drawn at its root from the aspect of the spirit of the tzadik, which is the aspect of the spirit of prophecy, through which the imaginative faculty is clarified, through which faith is clarified — which is the aspect of “a G-d-fearing woman” — from which come all the begettings.

And the more that a soul from Israel is born, it is the aspect of the renewal of the world, for man is a microcosm. And every person is the aspect of an entirely new matter and a completely new intellect, as is explained in our words elsewhere — that even a gilgul (reincarnation) is not reincarnated exactly as he was originally, but rather this nefesh with this ruach, etc. And it is all for the sake of publicizing and revealing His faithfulness, blessed be He, in the aspect of: “And from generation to generation is His faithfulness” (Tehillim 100:5).

And the more that souls multiply and the house of prayer grows greater through the multiplication of houses, etc., through this the aspect of the spirit of prophecy grows greater. For the spirit of prophecy comes from the souls of Israel, as is explained there. Therefore, the more that the permutations of souls multiply, the spirit of prophecy that comes from them grows and increases all the more. And through this one can beget yet more souls, more and more, who will reveal the faith even more. And so it goes, round and round. And through this the redemption will come, as mentioned above — for the son of David will not come until all the souls in the guf (the celestial repository of souls) are completed.

And through all of the above is drawn the voice of the melody that is explained there — which waters the garden, etc. — through which the akeiv d’kedushah (the “heel” of holiness) prevails over the akeiv d’Sitra Achara (the “heel” of the Other Side), in the aspect of: “And his hand grasped the heel of Esav” (Bereishis 25:26), as is explained there; see there well. And this is the aspect of the musical instruments that are played at a wedding. For the essential purpose of the wedding is for the sake of begetting, etc. — through which is drawn the aforementioned voice of melody.

And one who dies without children, may the Merciful One save us, is blemished in all of the above. And therefore he does not enter the pargod d’Malka (the curtain of the King), as it is in the holy Zohar. And therefore his soul remains bound to the heel of his brother, as is brought. For the blemish reaches as far as there — to the aspect of the akeiv (heel) — in that he did not merit to spread forth and to beget, through which all the aforementioned tikkunim would have been made, until the aspect of the akeiv d’kedushah (heel of holiness) would have been rectified, as mentioned above. And therefore his soul is bound there, in the aspect of the heel.

And therefore his tikkun is through his brother, who is adjacent to him in the permutations of the letters. For the six hundred thousand souls of Israel are the aspect of the six hundred thousand letters of the Torah, and every individual of Israel has a letter in the Torah, and every letter is comprised of all the letters. And likewise, every soul is comprised of all the souls — only that its essence is grasped in this letter. And just as in the Torah there are parashiyos and p’sukim and words and letters, so too among the souls there are tribes and families and ancestral houses, etc. And each person together with his brother is like a single word in the Torah that has several letters — so too in his father’s house there are several souls of his brothers. It follows that his brother is adjacent to him in the aforementioned permutations of the letters. Therefore he has the power to redeem him through the secret of yibum.

And the essential tikkun of yibum is through the aspect of hahu rucha d’shadei b’gavah (that spirit which he casts into her) — that is, the aspect of the spirit of prophecy mentioned above, which is drawn at its root from the tzadik, from which comes begetting, as mentioned above. And therefore through hahu rucha (that spirit) he can rectify him, for he is reformed and refashioned through hahu rucha — through which faith is clarified and one merits the aspect of the renewal of the world, from which comes the tikkun.

And therefore, when he does not wish to perform yibum, then: “She shall remove his shoe from upon his foot” (Devarim 25:9) — to show him that he has blemished in the aspect of the akeiv (heel), as mentioned above. For all the blemish is drawn from the sin of Adam HaRishon, in that he did not merit to rectify it according to his portion. And the essential sin and blemish of Adam HaRishon was in the aspect of the akeiv — through the serpent who was cunning, from which come all the damages, as is explained in the aforementioned Torah. For through this he caused: “And you shall bruise him on the heel” (Bereishis 3:15) — from which comes the power of the heel of Esav, which is the contamination of the serpent.

And the tikkun is through the voice of the melody explained there, which is drawn through the clarification of faith, etc., which is the aspect of: “I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid” (Bereishis 3:10), as is explained there. And then, after the tikkun began, it is written: “And Hashem Elokim made for Adam and for his wife garments of skin, and He clothed them” (Bereishis 3:21) — the secret of the shoes, as is brought.

And therefore this yavam (levir) who does not wish to perform yibum, and this indicates that he does not have the power to draw all the aforementioned tikkunim — therefore: “She shall remove his shoe from upon his foot,” etc., and she shall answer and say: “So shall it be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s house,” etc. (Devarim 25:9). For there is the blemish in the aspect of the shoes, which are the aspect of the garments of skin, which are the aspect of the tikkun of the heel, as mentioned above.

And this is: “And she shall spit in his face” (Devarim 25:9) — which is the aspect of disgrace, the opposite of kavod (honor). For the spirit of prophecy mentioned above is drawn from kavod, as is explained there. And therefore this one who has blemished in this has blemished in kavod. And therefore: “she shall spit in his face” — which is the opposite of kavod.

May it be His will that He save us and all His people Israel, that they should not come to chalitzah and yibum. And may it speedily be fulfilled: “The smallest shall become a thousand, and the youngest a mighty nation; I am Hashem — in its time I will hasten it” (Yeshayah 60:22). Blessed is Hashem forever, Amein and Amein. “Hashem shall reign forever; your G-d, O Tziyon, from generation to generation, Halleluyah!” (Tehillim 146:10)

segments.he: אות ע וכל זה צריכין לקשר למ"ש (בסי' ס"א) על פסוק אני היום ילדתיך ע"ש שמשיח יזכה לבחי' למעלה מהמזון וכו'. וכל אחד צריך להמשיך על עצמו בחי' זאת בכח הצדיקי אמת הממשיכין אורו של משיח בכל דור ודור בכל אדם ובכל זמן על כל מי שרוצה להתקרב להש"י שהעיקר הואע"י בחי' את זאת שיחשוב בכל יום ובכל עת ובכל רגע שאין לו אלא אותה הרגע וכאלו נולד עתה. כי באמת מי שיש לו שכל אין הזמן כלום כי העבר אין והעתיד עדיין וההוה כהרף עין כמובא מזה גם אצל המחקרים. והמשכיל יכול להבין שאין שום זמן כ"א רגע אחת בכל עת. ואותה הרגע ג"כ אינה כלום נגד השכל שלמעלה מזהכי באמת אין שום זמן כלל וכמבואר היטב בהתורה הנ"ל. ועיקר ההעלמה שהעלים הש"י השכל האמתי מהעולם שעי"ז התהוות הזמן הוא רק בשביל הבחירה וכמבואר מזה במ"א בדברינו. אבל גם בשכלינו שנדמה שיש זמן יכולים ג"כ להבין שכל הזמן הוא רק רגע ממש שהוא הרגע קלה שעומד בה עתהכי העבר אין וכ'. ועיקר לקשר אותה הרגע להש"י לבחי' למעלה מהזמן. ומ ישמשים לב להסתכל על זה יוכל תמיד בכל עת ורגע להתחיל לקשר עצמו ולדבק עצמו להש"י שזהו בחי' מצות הדביקות בו ית' שהוא מ"ע בתורה כ"ש את ה' אלהיך תירא אותו תעבוד ובו תדבק וכתיב אחרי ה' אלהיכם תלכו ואתו תיראו ובקולו תשמעו ואותו תעבודו ובו תדבקון. כי ע"פ הנ"ל יוכל כ"א מכל מקום שהוא אפי' משאול תחתיות ממש לדבק עצמו בהש"י בכל רגע שירצה. וזה בחי' ראו עתה כי אני אני הוא ראו עתה דייקא כי ע"י בחי' עתה כנ"ל תוכלו לראות כי אני אני הוא. ודעת לנבון נקל שענין זה א"א להסביר בפה מכ"ש בכתב רק כל חד כפום מה דמשער בלבי' יכול לתפוס מזה רמזים אמתיים לדבק עצמו להש"י בכל עת מכל מקום שהוא ועל זה נאמר אשכילך ואורך בדרך זו תלך איעצה עליך עיני:

אות עא וכל זה הוא בחי' מאמר רז"ל הנ"ל בענין ג' דברים שבאים בהיסח הדעת שהם משיח מציאה ועקרב. נמצא שהכל תלוי ברגע וזה בחי' לך עמי בא בחדריך וסגור דלתיך בעדך שצריכין לבא באיזה חדשר ולסגור הדלת בעדו ולהתבודד בינו לבין קונו, חבי כמעט רגע עד יעבור זעם שהעיקר להתחבא עצמו רגע קלה ולדלג באותה הרגע על מה שצריך לדלג להמתיק החרון אף שמשם בחי' נשיכת עקרב ח"ו, ולזכות למצוא טוב אמתי שהוא בחי' מציאה שזהו בחי' כי רגע באפו חיים ברצונו. שע"י בחי' רצון וכיסופין טובים זוכין לחיים אמתיים לבטל החרון אף שבאותו הרגע שכל זה זוכין בכחן של הצדיקים אמתיים שהם בחי' משיח כנ"ל. וזהו שהקדים שם זמרו לה' חסידיו וכו' כי רגע וכו' כי עיקר התיקון ע"י חסידיו שהם הצדיקים אמתיים וכנ"ל. וזהו שנסמך לזה ואני אמרתי בשלוי בל אמוט לעולם ה' ברצונך העמדת להררי עוז וכו' היינו כל הנ"ל שאין האדם יודע כלל מה נעשה עמו בכל יום כי הכל בא בהיסח הדעת כנ"ל וצריכין רק לתלות עיניו למרום כנ"ל, שכל זה מבואר היטב בפסוקים אלו שנסמכו אחר כי רגע באפו חיים ברצונו בער ילין בכי ולבגר רנה. ואני אמרתי בשלוי בל אמוט לעולם ה' ברצונך העמדת להררי עוז וכו' היינו כל הנ"ל שאין האדם יודע כלל מה נעשה עמו בכל יום כי הכל בא בהיסח הדעת כנ"ל וצריכין רק לתלות עיניו למרום כנ,ל, שכל זה מבואר היטב בפסוקים אלו שנסמכו אחר כי רגע באפו חיים ברצונו בערב ילין בכי ולבקר רנה. ואני אמרתי בשלוי בל אמוט לעולם שבזה טועין העולם הרבה שכשמתחיל להם איזה בחי' שלוה סוברין שיהי' כן לעולם אבל אין האדם יודע כלל מה יולד יום כיה' ברצונך העמדתה להררי עוז שנתת לי איזה שלוה וכו' אבל תיכף כשהסתרת פניך הייתי נבהל. ע"כ אין עצה ותחבולה כ"א אליך ה' אקרא וכו' כי אין מנוס מכל מה שיכול לעבור על האדם כ"א לתלות עיניו למרום ולהקדים תפילה לצרה כשרז"ל. ואז הפכת מספדי למחול לי וכו' ותאזרני שמחה כי עיקר השמחה ע"י תפלה כנ"ל. וכל זה נאמר במזמור שי חנוכת הבית כי כל זה כלול בהנ"ל:

אות עב וזה בהעלותך את הנרות אל מול פני המנורה יאירו שבעת הנרות. שבעת הנרות הם בחי' שבעה רועים שמכינסין ומאירין האמונה הקדושה בישראל. אבל א"א להתקרב אליהם כ"א ע"י עזות דקדושה שמקבלין ע"י שני הכתרים שהם בחי' נעשהונשמע וכו'. וכבר מבואר לעיל שקשה להבין מהיכן ההתחלה וכו'. ובאמת הכל נעשהע"י הצדיקי אמת והעיקר ע"י הצדיק שהוא בחי' משה משיח שהוא כלול מכל התיקונים המבואריםבתורה הנ"ל. כי משה הוא אחד מהז' רועים וכלול מכולם כ"ש שם והוא בעצמו ממשיך שני הכתרים הנ"ל שהם בחי' נעשה ונמשע כ"ש בכתבים שמשה חזר וזכה בהכתרים הנ"ל כמובא מזה בכונת ישמח משה וכו'. והוא מאיר עלינו אור הכתרים הנ"ל ועי"ז אנו זוכין לשמחה בחי' עזות דקדושה ועי"ז זוכין להתקרב אליו שהוא כלליות השבעה רועים. שעי"ז מאיר וממשיך עלינו אמונה שלימה ונתתקן בחי' חותם הידין שעי"ז זוכין לחותם הרגלין וכו' שהוא ג"כ מתתקן רק על ידו כי רק הוא עושה שלום בי ישראל לאביהם שבשמים שטוען עם הש"י למה ה' יחרה אפך בעמך וכו'. נמצא שכל התיקונים מראש ועד סוף הכל על ידו והוא בחי' פני המנורה שכל השבעת הנרות מאירין על ידו. וזהו אל מול פני המנורה שהוא בחי' משה שכלול מכל התיקונים הנ"ל, יאירו שבעת הנרות כי א"א לקבל אורם כ"א על ידו כנ"ל. וזהו שכתוב הדלקת הנרות בלשון בהעלותך וכו' כי ע"י נרות המנורה מעלין כל הנפשות הנפולין בבחי' ירידה תכלית עלי' הנ"ל. כי כל נפש מישראל הוא בחי' נר כ"ש נר ה' נשמת אדם וכולם עולין מירידתן ומאירין בכח תיקון המנורה הנ"ל. וזוה וזה מעשה המנורה מקשה זהב עד ירכה עד פרחה מקשה היא, מקשה פרש"י שהיתה כל המנורה עשוי' מעשת אחד מראש ועד סוף היינו שכל תקוני המנורה כולם תלויים זה בזה וכולם נעשים מעשת אחד. להורות שכולם נעש/ים מהצדיק בחי' משה בעצמו שממנו כל התיקונים הנ"ל מראש ועד סוף. וזהו עד ירכה עד פרחה מקשה היא, שהצדיק הנ"ל ממשיך כל התיקונים הנ"ל עד שמכניס בחי' עקשנות ועזות דקדושה גם בדיוטא התחתונה מאד בבחי' ירכין ורגלין בבחי' עד ירכה עד פרחה מקשה היא. וזה בחי' עד פרחה בחי' פריחת וזריחת והתנוצצות אלקותו ית' שמאיר גם בבחי' רגלין וירך, שמגודל העזות דקדושה שמכניס בכ"א מישראל ע"י כל התיקונים הנ"ל, עי"ז פורח ומתנוצץ אור זריחת אלקותו ית' גם בבחי' ירך ור גלין בבחי' עד ירכה עד פרחה מקשה היא. וזהו כמראה אשר הראה ה' את משה כן עשה את המנורה ודר"ל שהי' משה מתקשה על מעשה המנורה עד שהראה לו הש"י מנורה של אש וכו'. כי באמ תהכל מאתו ית' כיכל התיקונים הנ"ל נעשין ע"י תורת ה' ותפילת ה' בעצמו כביכול שזהו בחי' המנורה שהראה לו מלמעלה. וכן עשה משהעאת המנורה כי הוא נכלל בו ית' וזכה ג"כ לבחי' תורת ה' ותפלת ה' שעי"ז נמשכין כל החסדים העליונים ונתתקנים כל התיקונים הנ"ל הכלולים במנורה. וע"כ נתקשה משה מאד על מעשה המנורה מחמת שראה שהכל נעשה מעשת א' והכל תלוי זה בזה ואין יודעין מהיכן ההתחלה ע"כ הי' קשה בעיניו מאד איך מכניסין ומאירין תקונים אלו בישראל. עד שהראה לו הש"י שהכל ממנו ית' רק העיקר הוא הרצון האמת שמי שירצה באמת ברצונות חזקים להתקרב להש"י יזכה לכל זה וכנ"ל. וזה שכתוב בסוף מראה המנורה של זכרי' לא בחיל ולא בכח כיאם ברוחי וכו' בחי' רצון. כי העיקר תלוי ברצון טוב וחזק ימים ושנים להש"י באמת לאמתו עי"ז יזכה לכל הנ"ל וכנ"ל:

אות עג ע"פ הנ"ל מבואר עוצם גדולת קדושת נר חנוכה שהוא בחי' הדלקת נרות המנורה. כי אורם הקדוש נמשך מבחי' אורו של משיח בח'י ערכתי נר למשיחי כי הוא יזכה לבחי' משפט וצדקה בשלימות שעי"זעיקר קיום העולם ע"י שהוא ית' בעצמו ממתיק המשפט בצדקה בדרכים נפלאים בכל יום ובכל עת ובכל שעהו וכו' וכנ"ל. וזה שכתוב במדרש הנעלם פ' נח הובא בילקוט הראובני פ' בהעלותך וז"ל והנה עלה זית טרף בפיה לולא שהעיר הקב"ה רוח הכהנים שהיו מדליקין נרות בשמן זית אז אבדה פליטת יהודה מן העולם. נמצא שעיקר קיומינו הוא ע"י הנרות בשמן זית של המנורה שהוא בחי' נר חנוכה היינו כנ"ל:
